ios.desc:
iKeePass – Your secure password vault for iPhone and iPad.

Your passwords deserve the best protection. iKeePass brings the full power of the KeePass format natively to your iPhone and iPad – with a beautiful, intuitive interface.

MILITARY-GRADE ENCRYPTION
AES-256 and ChaCha20 protect every single entry. With Argon2d and Argon2id, cracking your master password becomes virtually impossible.

SECURITY DASHBOARD
How healthy are your passwords? The dashboard shows you weak, duplicate and outdated passwords at a glance.

ONE-TIME PASSWORDS (TOTP)
Two-factor authentication built right in. No additional app needed – your TOTP codes are always at your fingertips.

CLOUD SYNC
Sync your password database via Nextcloud (WebDAV), Dropbox, OneDrive or Google Drive. Or open KDBX files directly from your device.

KEEPASS FORMAT
No vendor lock-in: Your data belongs to you. Full compatibility with KDBX 3.x and 4.x for maximum freedom.

BIOMETRIC UNLOCK
Unlock your vault in a flash with Face ID or Touch ID.

More info at https://ikeepass.de
